cards.imageAlt: Figure 12，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: Please describe the picture briefly in your own words.
cards.audioTextZh: 请用你自己的语言简略描述这张图片。
cards.referenceText: In the picture, I can see a policeman is checking items carried by passengers at the airport. The policeman is holding a bottle and telling a lady the bottle can not be carried in the airplane, maybe it is a bottle of shampoo.
cards.referenceTextZh: 从这张图中我看到一个警察正在机场检查乘客携带的行李，这个警察正拿着一个瓶子告诉一位女士这个瓶子无法带上飞机，瓶子里的物品有可能是洗发水。

cards.audioText: Do you know anything about dangerous goods? Can you name a few?
cards.audioTextZh: 你了解危险物品吗？能列举一些吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, dangerous goods are also called hazardous materials, including explosive material, flammable material/liquid/solid/gas, corrosive liquid, radioactive material, magnetic solid, and so on. They may harm people, aircraft or environment during transportation.
cards.referenceTextZh: 了解，危险物品也可以被称为有害物质，包括易爆炸物、易燃物/液体/固体/气体、腐蚀性液体、放射性物品，磁性固体等。这些物品在运输途中可能对人体、飞机或环境产生伤害。

cards.audioText: What factors should the crew members consider beforehand if there are dangerous goods on board?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果机上有危险物品，机组人员应事先考虑到什么？
cards.referenceText: First, the crew members should have been trained about dangerous goods transportation. Second, after being notified of the dangerous goods, the pilots should understand the nature of the goods and confirm the package and position of the goods in the hold. In the air, when something abnormal happens, the pilots should report the situation about the goods to ATC and request to land at the nearest airport as soon as possible.
cards.referenceTextZh: 第一，机组成员应该已全部接受过危险物品运输培训；第二，被告知机上有危险物品后，飞行员要了解危险物品的性质，并确定危险物品的包装方式和其在货舱中的位置。飞行途中，当异常情况发生时，飞行员应该将危险物品的情况报告给ATC，并要求尽快在最近的机场着陆。

cards.audioText: The Dispatch Center told you there was bomb on board after your takeoff, what should you do then?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞机起飞后签派中心告知飞机上有炸弹，这时你应该怎样做？
cards.referenceText: I will ask them to contact the nearest airport with explosive ordnance disposal (EOD) facility for our landing, and then I will report my condition to ATC for further emergency arrangement.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我会要求签派中心联系最近的机场，并申请着陆后的爆炸军械处理设备。然后我会将情况报告给ATC等待紧急部署。

cards.audioText: Does your company provide dangerous goods transportation training? What have you learnt in the training?
cards.audioTextZh: 你的公司是否提供危险物品运输培训吗？你在培训中学到了什么？
cards.referenceText: Yes, according to CAAC regulation, we should have dangerous cargo training every two years. In the training, we learn about dangerous goods. For example, risk, package, classification, and disposal procedures in case of leaking and contamination.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，根据民航总局规定，飞行员每两年要接受危险物品运输培训。在培训中，我们会学习危险物品相关内容，例如危险物品的风险、包装方法、类别和发生泄漏和污染时的处理程序。

cards.audioText: How do you think of the airport security check?
cards.audioTextZh: 你对机场安检有什么看法？
cards.referenceText: I think airport security check is very important to flight safety. Because large numbers of people pass through airports every day, this presents potential targets for terrorism and other forms of crime, so I think the security check cannot be too strict, and more work needs to be done to make people obey the aviation safety regulations.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我认为机场安检对于飞行安全非常重要，因为机场每天有大量人群往来，为恐怖行为或其它犯罪提供潜在目标。所以我认为安检应尽可能严格，并且需要开展更多工作让人们遵守航空安全条例。

cards.audioText: Do you have such experience that dangerous goods are onboard?
cards.audioTextZh: 你经历过机上出现危险物品的情况吗？
cards.referenceText: Once two women and a child took some firecrackers onboard without being known. A flight attendant found the dangerous good in the halfway and reported to the captain at once. At last we landed at the nearest alternate airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经历过，有一次，两位女士和一名儿童在未被发现的情况下携带鞭炮上飞机，乘务员在半途中发现了危险物品并立刻报告机长，最后飞机在最近的备降机场降落了。
